     end

+  # ── error set #4: protocol-bound violation (Rian.Check.check_bounds, ADR-0042 §2) ──
+  # at each call to a bounded generic (`def g(x T) … forall T: P`), instantiate the
+  # callee's tvars from the argument types (`bind_all`, reused from generic-return
+  # inference) and check each bound `T: P`: a tvar pinned to a CONCRETE type with no
+  # `impl P for that-type` is a proven violation. `fbounds` maps a bounded function to
+  # its (tvars, param types, bounds); `impls` maps a protocol to its implementing types.
+  # CONSERVATIVE: an `unknown`/still-generic instantiation never rejects. `bounds_bad`
+  # walks one clause body for such a call, mirroring `num_mix`'s shape.
+  pub def bounds_bad(Core, Dict(String, String), Dict(Symbol, Dict(String, String)), Dict(String, FBnd), Dict(String, Vec(String))) Bool
+  pub def bounds_bad(CNum(_), _, _, _, _) := false
+  pub def bounds_bad(CStr(_), _, _, _, _) := false
+  pub def bounds_bad(CChar(_), _, _, _, _) := false
+  pub def bounds_bad(CId(_), _, _, _, _) := false
+  pub def bounds_bad(CUnary(_, a), env, ic, fb, im) := bounds_bad(a, env, ic, fb, im)
+  pub def bounds_bad(CBin(_, l, r), env, ic, fb, im) := bounds_bad(l, env, ic, fb, im) or bounds_bad(r, env, ic, fb, im)
+  pub def bounds_bad(CCall(g, args), env, ic, fb, im) := call_bound_bad(g, args, env, ic, fb, im) or bounds_any(args, env, ic, fb, im)
+  pub def bounds_bad(CIf(c, t, e), env, ic, fb, im) := bounds_bad(c, env, ic, fb, im) or bounds_bad(t, env, ic, fb, im) or bounds_bad(e, env, ic, fb, im)
+  pub def bounds_bad(CBlock(stmts), env, ic, fb, im) := bounds_stmts(stmts, env, ic, fb, im)
+  pub def bounds_bad(CCase(s, arms), env, ic, fb, im) := bounds_bad(s, env, ic, fb, im) or bounds_arms(arms, env, ic, fb, im)
+  pub def bounds_bad(CList(es, tail), env, ic, fb, im) := bounds_any(es, env, ic, fb, im) or bounds_tail(tail, env, ic, fb, im)
+  pub def bounds_bad(CLambda(_, body), env, ic, fb, im) := bounds_bad(body, env, ic, fb, im)
+  pub def bounds_bad(_, _, _, _, _) := false
+
+  def bounds_any(Vec(Core), Dict(String, String), Dict(Symbol, Dict(String, String)), Dict(String, FBnd), Dict(String, Vec(String))) Bool
+  def bounds_any([], _, _, _, _) := false
+  def bounds_any([c | rest], env, ic, fb, im) := bounds_bad(c, env, ic, fb, im) or bounds_any(rest, env, ic, fb, im)
+
+  def bounds_stmts(Vec(Stmt), Dict(String, String), Dict(Symbol, Dict(String, String)), Dict(String, FBnd), Dict(String, Vec(String))) Bool
+  def bounds_stmts([], _, _, _, _) := false
+  def bounds_stmts([SBind(_, e) | rest], env, ic, fb, im) := bounds_bad(e, env, ic, fb, im) or bounds_stmts(rest, env, ic, fb, im)
+  def bounds_stmts([STypedBind(_, _, e) | rest], env, ic, fb, im) := bounds_bad(e, env, ic, fb, im) or bounds_stmts(rest, env, ic, fb, im)
+  def bounds_stmts([SExpr(e) | rest], env, ic, fb, im) := bounds_bad(e, env, ic, fb, im) or bounds_stmts(rest, env, ic, fb, im)
+
+  def bounds_arms(Vec(Arm), Dict(String, String), Dict(Symbol, Dict(String, String)), Dict(String, FBnd), Dict(String, Vec(String))) Bool
+  def bounds_arms([], _, _, _, _) := false
+  def bounds_arms([CArm(_, body) | rest], env, ic, fb, im) := bounds_bad(body, env, ic, fb, im) or bounds_arms(rest, env, ic, fb, im)
+
+  def bounds_tail(Tail, Dict(String, String), Dict(Symbol, Dict(String, String)), Dict(String, FBnd), Dict(String, Vec(String))) Bool
+  def bounds_tail(TClose, _, _, _, _) := false
+  def bounds_tail(TCons(e), env, ic, fb, im) := bounds_bad(e, env, ic, fb, im)
+
+  # check one call against the callee's bounds, if it targets a bounded generic.
+  def call_bound_bad(g String, args Vec(Core), env Dict(String, String), ic Dict(Symbol, Dict(String, String)), fb Dict(String, FBnd), im Dict(String, Vec(String))) Bool
+  def call_bound_bad(g, args, env, ic, fb, im)
+    if Prim.map_has(fb, g) do
+      fbound_violated(Prim.map_get(fb, g), infer_args(args, env, ic), im)
+    else
+      false
+    end
+  end
+
+  def fbound_violated(FBnd, Vec(String), Dict(String, Vec(String))) Bool
+  def fbound_violated(FB(tvars, params, bounds), arg_types, im) := violated(bounds, bind_all(params, arg_types, tvars, []), im)
+
+  def infer_args(Vec(Core), Dict(String, String), Dict(Symbol, Dict(String, String))) Vec(String)
+  def infer_args([], _, _) := []
+  def infer_args([a | rest], env, ic) := [infer_ic(a, env, ic) | infer_args(rest, env, ic)]
+
+  # each bound `tvar: P + Q`: if the tvar is pinned to a concrete type, every protocol
+  # must have an impl for it; a missing one is a violation.
+  def violated(Vec(ProtoBound), Vec(Bind), Dict(String, Vec(String))) Bool
+  def violated([], _, _) := false
+  def violated([PBound(tvar, protos) | rest], binds, im) := pbound_violated(tvar, protos, binds, im) or violated(rest, binds, im)
+
+  def pbound_violated(tvar String, protos Vec(String), binds Vec(Bind), im Dict(String, Vec(String))) Bool
+  def pbound_violated(tvar, protos, binds, im)
+    case bind_lookup(binds, tvar) do
+      TyHit(ty) -> if concrete_ty(ty) do missing_impl(protos, ty, im) else false end
+      TyMiss -> false
+    end
+  end
+
+  def concrete_ty(ty String) Bool := if ty == "unknown" do false else not has_tvar(ty) end
+
+  def missing_impl(Vec(String), String, Dict(String, Vec(String))) Bool
+  def missing_impl([], _, _) := false
+  def missing_impl([p | rest], ty, im) := not impl_has(im, p, ty) or missing_impl(rest, ty, im)
+
+  def impl_has(im Dict(String, Vec(String)), proto String, ty String) Bool
+  def impl_has(im, proto, ty) := if Prim.map_has(im, proto) do member_str(ty, Prim.map_get(im, proto)) else false end
+
+  def bind_lookup(Vec(Bind), String) TyLk
+  def bind_lookup([], _) := TyMiss
+  def bind_lookup([Bnd(tv, ty) | rest], x) := if tv == x do TyHit(ty) else bind_lookup(rest, x) end
+
   # `from` is assignable to `to` (Rian.Check.assignable?): identical, either unknown, or an
   # `Fn(...)` on either side (skipped, see above); else for two numerics a lossless WIDENING;
   # else exact unification must not mismatch.

+defmodule Rian.CheckerBoundsFixpointTest do
+  # async: false — loads compiler/checker.rian into the VM via :code.load_binary.
+  use ExUnit.Case, async: false
+
+  alias Rian.{Beam, Core, Check, Decl, Pratt}
+
+  # Self-hosting fixpoint (ADR-0063) for the type checker's FOURTH ERROR SET — the
+  # PROTOCOL-BOUND violation (Rian.Check.check_bounds, ADR-0042 §2). At a call to a
+  # bounded generic (`def g(x T) … forall T: P`), `compiler/checker.rian`'s
+  # `bounds_bad/5` instantiates the callee's tvars from the argument types (`bind_all`,
+  # reused from generic-return inference) and returns `true` iff a bound `T: P`
+  # instantiates `T` to a CONCRETE type with no `impl P for that-type`.
+  #
+  # The port needs two tables the reference builds in `program_ic`: `fbounds` (a bounded
+  # function's tvars/param-types/bounds) and `impls` (protocol → implementing types). The
+  # test derives BOTH from the real `Check.program_ic`, projects them to the port's tuple
+  # shape, and feeds the caller's body Core to `bounds_bad`.
+  #
+  # LOCK: for each corpus program the port's `bounds_bad` over the caller's body must
+  # AGREE with whether the real `Check.check/1` reports the bound violation.
+
+  setup_all do
+    {:ok, mod} = Beam.load(File.read!("compiler/checker.rian"), :rian_checker_bounds_fixpoint)
+    {:ok, mod: mod}
+  end
+
+  @proto """
+  protocol Show do
+    def show(self Self) String
+  end
+
+  impl Show for Int53 do
+    def show(x) := "ok"
+  end
+
+  def render(v C) String forall C: Show := show(v)
+  """
+
+  # {label, caller name, full program source}.
+  # NEGATIVE = a provable bound violation → BOTH the port and Rian.Check must flag it.
+  @negative [
+    {"render(String) — no `impl Show for String`", "bad",
+     @proto <> "\ndef bad() String := render(\"hi\")"},
+    {"render(Float64) — no `impl Show for Float64`", "badf",
+     @proto <> "\ndef badf() String := render(3.0)"}
+  ]
+
+  # POSITIVE = NO violation → BOTH must pass: the arg's inferred type HAS the impl, or
+  # the instantiation stays generic (a forwarded type variable — conservatively unchecked).
+  @positive [
+    {"render(Int53) — `impl Show for Int53` exists", "good",
+     @proto <> "\ndef good() String := render(5)"},
+    {"render(C) — the tvar stays generic, never rejected", "relay",
+     @proto <> "\ndef relay(z C) String forall C: Show := render(z)"}
+  ]
+
+  defp inj(%Core.ENum{text: t}), do: {:c_num, t}
+  defp inj(%Core.EStr{value: v}), do: {:c_str, v}
+  defp inj(%Core.EChar{value: c}), do: {:c_char, c}
+  defp inj(%Core.EId{name: n}), do: {:c_id, n}
+  defp inj(%Core.EUnary{op: op, arg: a}), do: {:c_unary, op, inj(a)}
+  defp inj(%Core.EBin{op: op, left: l, right: r}), do: {:c_bin, op, inj(l), inj(r)}
+  defp inj(%Core.ECall{fun: %Core.EId{name: f}, args: as}), do: {:c_call, f, Enum.map(as, &inj/1)}
+  defp inj(%Core.EIf{cond: c, then: t, else: e}), do: {:c_if, inj(c), inj(t), inj(e)}
+  defp inj(%Core.EBlock{stmts: stmts}), do: {:c_block, Enum.map(stmts, &inj_stmt/1)}
+  defp inj(%Core.ECase{scrut: s, arms: arms}), do: {:c_case, inj(s), Enum.map(arms, &inj_arm/1)}
+
+  defp inj(%Core.EList{elems: elems, tail: tail}),
+    do: {:c_list, Enum.map(elems, &inj/1), inj_tail(tail)}
+
+  defp inj(%Core.ELambda{params: ps, body: body}),
+    do: {:c_lambda, Enum.map(ps, &inj_param/1), inj(body)}
+
+  defp inj_tail(nil), do: :t_close
+  defp inj_tail(:close), do: :t_close
+  defp inj_tail(tail), do: {:t_cons, inj(tail)}
+  defp inj_param({n, nil}), do: {:lp, n, :pt_none}
+  defp inj_param({n, t}), do: {:lp, n, {:pt_some, t}}
+  defp inj_stmt({:expr, e}), do: {:s_expr, inj(e)}
+  defp inj_stmt({:bind, n, e}), do: {:s_bind, n, inj(e)}
+  defp inj_stmt({:typed_bind, n, ann, e}), do: {:s_typed_bind, n, ann, inj(e)}
+  defp inj_arm({pat, _guard, body}), do: {:c_arm, inj_pat(pat), inj(body)}
+  defp inj_pat(%Core.PVar{name: n}), do: {:p_var, n}
+  defp inj_pat(%Core.PCtor{ctor: c, args: args}), do: {:p_ctor, c, Enum.map(args, &inj_pat/1)}
+  defp inj_pat(_), do: :p_other
+
+  # project the reference's `ic.fbounds` (`%{g => %{params, tvars, bounds}}`) and
+  # `ic.impls` (`%{proto => MapSet}`) into the port's tuple shape: `{:fb, tvars, params,
+  # [{:p_bound, tvar, protos}]}` and `%{proto => [types]}`.
+  defp port_fbounds(fbounds) do
+    Map.new(fbounds, fn {g, %{params: params, tvars: tvars, bounds: bounds}} ->
+      pbounds = Enum.map(bounds, fn {tv, protos} -> {:p_bound, tv, protos} end)
+      {g, {:fb, tvars, params, pbounds}}
+    end)
+  end
+
+  defp port_impls(impls), do: Map.new(impls, fn {p, tys} -> {p, MapSet.to_list(tys)} end)
+
+  defp caller(src, name) do
+    prog = Decl.parse(src)
+    Enum.find(prog.funcs, &(&1.name == name))
+  end
+
+  defp port_bounds(mod, src, name) do
+    ic = Check.program_ic(Decl.parse(src))
+    f = caller(src, name)
+    env = Map.new(f.params, fn p -> {p.name, p.type} end)
+    body = inj(Core.from_expr(Pratt.parse_body(hd(f.clauses).body)))
+    mod.bounds_bad(body, env, %{}, port_fbounds(ic.fbounds), port_impls(ic.impls))
+  end
+
+  defp ref_bounds(src) do
+    case Check.check(src) do
+      :ok -> false
+      {:error, msg} -> String.contains?(msg, "requires") and String.contains?(msg, "has no `impl")
+    end
+  end
+
